items.t: RealReal Stock Is Up 13.8% What’s Changed
items.sum: The RealReal reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$206.12 million and net income of US$16.01 million, raised full year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of US$806 million to US$810 million, and added former Match Group CEO Shar Dubey to its board alongside eBay fashion leader Alexis Hoopes as Chief Merchandising Officer.
